headline: World Blue ($300) is the best referrer bonus a $30,000 deposit qualifies for; the only soft spots are a corrupted value and "international businesses" wording in the World Blue documents.

issues.summary: The required World Blue documents carry a corrupted value ("$140 supported regions"), and doc_007 frames the program as referring "other international businesses". The qualification list in doc_001 has no international requirement, so World Blue remains correct.
evidence: doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_001: "within the $140 supported regions" / "Supported regions for payments | $140"
doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_007: "you can earn rewards by referring other international businesses to World Blue"
doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_001: "For a referral to qualify: The referred business must open a World Blue account; They must deposit at least $25,000 within 90 days"
replay: submit_referral "Lime Green Account" instead -> verified match False (referrals differs)
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that treats "international" as an eligibility condition for a domestic consulting LLC would recommend Lime Green ($200) and fail. The documented qualification criteria do not support that reading, so the defect is cosmetic.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the "$140" template value and drop "international" from the world_blue_007 referral sentence.

solution_check: Tenure: Navy Blue opened 11/10/2023, about 2 years, so every tenure threshold is met. Last referral 10/30, 15 days ago, so the window is clear. With a $30,000 deposit: World Blue $300 ($25k minimum, 90-day tenure), Lime Green $200, Hunter Green $175 (9/10 used), Cobalt $150, Navy $100; True Blue ($50k) and Beige ($100k) do not qualify. World Blue is the unique maximum and matches gold[4].
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean. The doc corruption/wording is a newly noted cosmetic Minor that does not change the answer.
notes: The gold read get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is required; skipping it fails even under the verified scorer, because the gold tool name is then missing from agent_discoverable_tools (same mechanism replayed on task_100). The v1.0.1 fix to beige_012 ("$120 days" to "120 days") has no effect here.
